goal: Freeze the executor contract, Vulkan stage chain, RHI reuse boundary, and D3D12 parity target before code cleanup starts.

checkpoints.title: One backend executor contract
checkpoints.rule: RHIExecutor owns one backend executor instance behind one shared lifecycle.
must_be_true: Static backend utility entrypoints are not target architecture.
Vulkan and D3D12 implement the same public executor lifecycle.

checkpoints.title: Single-owner Flush and Sync semantics
checkpoints.rule: Flush and Sync semantics are explicit depth semantics with one owner each.
must_be_true: RHITranslate and SubmitGPU are progression depths.
RHI and Present are sync depths.
No target design keeps duplicated SubmitGPU progression in both RHIExecutor and backend ingress.

checkpoints.title: Fixed Vulkan stage chain
checkpoints.rule: The Vulkan chain is fixed as ingress -> preprocess -> parallel translate -> submission runtime -> interrupt runtime.
must_be_true: Parallel translate owns host-side translation scheduling and native recording only.
Submission runtime owns GPU submit, present ordering, and sync boundary materialization only.
Interrupt runtime owns completion polling, callbacks, and profiler-visible completion only.

checkpoints.title: Fixed RHI reuse boundary
checkpoints.rule: Only proven backend-agnostic behavior may move to RHI.
must_be_true: Admission, flush-depth semantics, job metadata, and translate scheduling contracts are RHI candidates.
Backend-specific preprocess, native translation, submit encoding, and completion polling remain backend-owned.
No wrapper-only abstraction is accepted as reuse.

checkpoints.title: Fixed D3D12 parity target
checkpoints.rule: D3D12 follows the Vulkan executor contract after Vulkan cleanup. No separate long-term execution path is allowed.
must_be_true: D3D12 parity is defined as the same public executor lifecycle.
D3D12-specific code is limited to backend-owned stage internals.
No D3D12-only admission or sync surface is retained in the target design.

checkpoints.title: Locked validation and update contract
checkpoints.rule: Validation and document updates are part of the stage contract.
must_be_true: testscripts/test_rhi_translate.ps1 is the first validation gate.
testscripts/test_all.ps1 is the milestone-sized validation gate.
Milestone and active checkpoint files are updated together.

completion_gate: The Vulkan stage chain is fixed.
The RHI reuse boundary is fixed.
The D3D12 parity target is fixed.
Baseline validation passed before the stage was marked complete.
validation: Stage execution in this file is document execution only.
Re-open M1 only if the executor contract changes.
Keep using existing repository scripts only.
